common.unauthorized: Not authorised: open Rhizome from the link printed by `rhz serve` or from the desktop app.

search.empty_hint: Try fewer filters, an accession, or a method name.

home.ingest_hint: Drop an RXF file exported from Claude or ChatGPT, or save it into the inbox folder.
home.drop: Drop RXF file here or click to choose
home.recall_placeholder: Paste an analysis plan, a paragraph or code…
home.recall_go: What have I read that helps?
home.tagline: What have you already read that helps right now?
home.tagline_sub: Papers you discussed, split into datasets, methods, ideas and claims — searchable, linked, and brought back when they matter.
home.step1: In Claude or ChatGPT, with the Rhizome export instructions in the Project.
home.step2: Save the YAML into the inbox folder or drop it here. Invalid files come back with a report to paste into the chat.
home.step3: Search by asset, open topic pages, and let recall surface what you forgot.
home.recall_hint: Paste what you are working on; Rhizome ranks your own assets by relevance × how long since you last saw them.
home.recall_empty_hint: Nothing above the relevance threshold. Try a more specific description.

paper.suspect: IDs that could not be verified and were not stored: {{ids}}

map.title: Topic map
map.empty: No topics yet. Ingest a few RXF exports first.
map.new_topic_hint: The whole library is retro-tagged with the new topic; uncertain matches go to the review queue.
map.name: Name (short English noun phrase)
map.created: Topic created; retro-tagging runs in the background.
map.sub: Only the topic layer is drawn; node size is the number of linked assets, colour is the community.
map.legend: Pale = candidate topic · click a node to open its page · hover to highlight neighbours
map.empty_hint: Topics appear as RXF exports mention them; confirm or create them to make them official.

review.title: Review queue
review.keys: Keyboard: j / k to move, 1–5 to choose an action, s to skip.
review.synthesis_note: What is the connection, and which problem could it help with? (becomes an Idea)

question.synthesis: Is the link between “{{a_name}}” and “{{b_name}}” useful?

review.empty_hint: New items arrive as papers are ingested and when topics are created.

cards.title: Review cards
cards.sub: Space shows the answer; 1–4 grades it.
cards.done_hint: Cards come from deep exports; new ones are limited per day in Settings.

digest.title: Weekly digest
digest.hint: Close assets with no path between them, from different communities. Ask Claude (rhz_digest) to explain the promising ones.
digest.no_pairs_hint: Run the batch, or wait for the weekly synthesis.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_hint: Paper content and your notes are never translated.
settings.models_hint: Models are downloaded on first use and can be switched off individually. Thresholds must be re-calibrated after switching.
settings.rebuild_hint: After changing models, recompute the graph from stored exports.
settings.remotes_hint: Targets for `rhz sync <name>`: name, host, path, optional control_path to reuse an authenticated SSH connection.
settings.vocab_hint: Put rhizome-vocab.yaml into the Claude / ChatGPT Project knowledge after topics change.
